rows.contract: a tsconfig afterDeclarations transformer is reported and skipped; declarations are still emitted and no marker reaches either the declaration or the Luau
rows.verification: TestFullForkParity compares the built Rotor binary with the FROZEN archive-captured project tree and the RE-FROZEN transcript
rows.implementationDetail: Rotor emits declarations from tsgo, which has no custom-transformer hook, so there is nowhere to run an afterDeclarations transformer; the build warns once per project instead of dropping it silently (internal/compile/afterdeclarations.go)
rows.reason: Re-frozen when declaration emit moved off the Node sidecar. The fork's contract was that the marker REACHES the .d.ts and not the .luau; the half that still holds (nothing leaks into Luau) is kept as a forbidden text, the half that cannot hold is inverted into a forbidden text on the .d.ts, and the warning is asserted on the diagnostic surface. The .d.ts is still required, so the row keeps proving that a project with an afterDeclarations plugin publishes declarations at all.
